title: TOWARD VIRTUOUS REINFORCEMENT LEARNING: A CRITIQUE AND ROADMAP
reasoning: The paper is a critique and roadmap focused entirely on machine ethics in reinforcement learning. It evaluates and compares the three main Western ethical frameworks (deontology, consequentialism, and virtue ethics) and explicitly incorporates global religious and philosophical traditions, including Confucianism, Daoism, and Persian/Islamic ethical concepts like Akhlaq and Adab.
